description: Use when you need image generation, an AI image generator or text to image from a prompt for illustrations, mockups or social posts. Do not use for image edits, specific sizes, photos of real people or more than one image per call. Returns JSON with an AI-generated image from a text prompt: a 1024x1024 JPEG made by FLUX.1 schnell on Workers AI, as base64 for 0.03 USDC per call. Result in the same call (about 10000 ms); a status tool polls for free if it takes longer. Category: Media.

prompt.description: What the image should show, in English, e.g. a lighthouse on a cliff at sunset, watercolor

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

steps.description: Diffusion steps (1-8, 4 when omitted); more steps, more detail
